1:_: Seif 2: And the same if some of them remained. And even if that remainder is four wide it is not nullified from the law of pas; and I would say for below seif 12. Tosafos Eruvin daf 5 s.v. it is not the law and daf 9b s.v. wall:
2:_: Seif 3: Ten tefachim. Spaced as below seif 26. As it appears to me:
3:_: Seif 6: It is required that the lechi. I question this — for behold this is included in seif 10. And why state twice:
4:_: Magen Avraham s.k. 5: The airspace comes. And so it is in Levush:
5:_: Seif 11: Such as if there was another lechi. I am in doubt if there was a partition and it fell on Shabbat and more than a tefach remained — whether we say it helps since that part was within the partition they relied on — it is called they relied on it; for on the entire partition they relied to permit carrying. And that part is included. And it appears reasonable that specifically they relied on it as lechi is required; for we hold lechi is for partition and partition standing by itself helps. And it implies also without relied such as if there was another partition and it fell on Shabbat and they now come to rely on this partition. And perforce this that with lechi it does not help requires recognition that we consider it a partition by relying on it initially. And if so relied as lechi is required. But from the sugya in Eruvin 93b it is difficult. And if there was a small courtyard breached to a large one — and the question: if so also the large to the thirteen — why was it dealing with breach on Shabbat; if so they did not rely from yesterday on the permission of the projections; perforce it is proven it is called relied since the projections were within the partition they relied on; unless we say pasin are preferable to lechi and do not require relied on it. If so one of these is proven — either in such a case it is called relied; or with pasin we do not require relied — requires study for the law:
6:_: And behold in the main passage of Dicha there is room to examine: from where do we know that when there was another lechi and it fell on Shabbat it does not help — perhaps we only say they did not rely except that they did not know from yesterday about this lechi or they did not carry on the past Shabbat through this lechi as Magen Avraham wrote in s.k. 9; but in such a case where there was another lechi — one may say since we hold on Shabbat once permitted, permitted; only when lechi fell — since there are no partitions — we do not say once permitted, permitted; if so perhaps since this lechi is a partition only lacking recognition — one may say we established it as a partition and we say once permitted, permitted; and from that in Eruvin 15:1 Rav sat in that mavo — they showed him and he stood in his place — there is no proof; for Rav according to his view holds even when partitions exist we do not say once permitted, permitted; and on the contrary with this it is more spacious — that which R' Huna said: the Master does not hold one may rely on a palm trunk; R' Huna according to his view holds when partitions exist we say once permitted, permitted — one may rely on a palm trunk; and perhaps since the baraita also teaches its beams fell — we hold korah is for recognition; if so when korah fell it is called partitions exist since only recognition is lacking; perforce nevertheless since the Sages said with three partitions one is not permitted except with recognition — where recognition was removed it is as if partitions were nullified; likewise this lechi without recognition is nullified there from partition rabbinically and still requires study:
7:_: Seif 16: Therefore if he made it from. I question why he was silent and did not distinguish that from asherah of a gentile it helps as below siman 386 seif 3:
8:_: There from asherah wood — invalid. And if with korah four wide it depends on two answers in Tosafos Eruvin chapter 6 in the reason that lechi is valid with asherah wood — explanation 1: since its width is mashehu they were not strict with it — see Magen Avraham s.k. 7; and if so here with korah even if its width is four it does not help with asherah wood; but according to R' Avraham that lechi if from attached plaster chips it is lechi — see Taz s.k. 5 and this is that korah cannot be through attached plaster chips for it requires fit to receive a brick; if so with korah four wide it helps with asherah wood for even though it is cut down it is like attached plaster chips and makes from them korah of four — as it appears to me:
9:_: Magen Avraham s.k. 16: With this suffices the length of the korah. For with nine amot and two mashehuyin suffices the length of the korah and from two ends we say lavud as written etc. — thus it should read:
10:_: Seif 26: Less than ten tefachim spaced. I am in doubt whether this general rule of the Sages' measures to be stringent with spaced and compressed is like a manner of doubt in which amot we measure and each time we take stringently; and if so when mavo is four wide metsumtsamet according to the other view 28 — its length of mavo four metsumtsamot and height nineteen metsumtsamot suffice to permit it with lechi — from necessity if we measure the mavo spaced it needs no correction since its width has no measure of four spaced; and if we measure metsumtsamot — automatically its length and height are measure; or this is from the essence of the law that where amot and tefachim are mentioned for leniency the explanation is spaced; and where stated for stringency — namely metsumtsamot; and as if the Sages explicitly said mavo four tefachim metsumtsamot requires correction with lechi and must be height nineteen spaced and length four spaced; and likewise in Kilayim fence breached in ten — namely metsumtsamot; and in such a case if distancing vineyard four metsumtsamot helps — since if we measure spaced automatically permitted because of fence since there is not eleven spaced; and it appears to me proof from Tosafos Eruvin 5:1 s.v. and if in four etc.; and even though four that R' Yosi says etc. — why did they not simply challenge that the four R' Yosi says is spaced for all barley for stringency is spaced; and if the measure of houses and courtyards open into it that opening measure four is also spaced — if so Tosafos did not challenge at all; for it is fine to say that the four R' Yosi says is literally four; and nevertheless its length is more than its width for the four is spaced and its width in four is metsumtsamot; and they challenge well: how do you find it — behold it requires open into it opening measure four spaced; perforce according to side one above; and if so we should not have challenged the three views that the four is spaced; for one may say the four R' Yosi says is according to its width four — if its width four metsumtsamot also its length in four metsumtsamot; and in the manner of from necessity as above; and they challenge well that in such a case where there are four metsumtsamot how do you find it; to this they challenged that also when its width four metsumtsamot it requires its length more than four metsumtsamot for behold it requires its length more than its width:
11:_: Further it appears to me proof from the sugya there from what Abbaye said: I would say from R' Huna that lechi protruding etc. and R' Yosi to remove from the law of lechi; and if it were that these measures of spaced and metsumtsamot are from the essence of the law — if so for Abbaye who removes from lechi depends on mavo measure — if lechi is mavo measure it removes from lechi; if so since mavo measure is four spaced — likewise protruding lechi should not remove from lechi until it is four spaced; and behold what R' Huna said four requires another lechi — certainly four metsumtsamot as the transmitted rule that amot for stringency are metsumtsamot; and even if we strain since he said like mavo we know it is spaced which is mavo measure; nevertheless for R' Yosi who does not tie this to mavo measure — for mavo measure is four tefachim — until four it does not remove from lechi; if so automatically four is metsumtsamot; for it is in the category of what they said all measures for stringency are metsumtsamot; and this is not implied that Rabbah and R' Yosi explicitly disagree on R' Huna's explanation of four requires another lechi; for not for Abbaye is four spaced; and for R' Yosi four is metsumtsamot; perforce according to side one above that measures are in the manner of doubt and stringently; therefore also for Abbaye that four requires another lechi is metsumtsamot; for what mavo measure four spaced is only in the manner of doubt and stringency; and if so conversely for judging it as lechi that left the law of lechi — since it has mavo measure — we also go stringently that metsumtsamot is mavo measure and requires another lechi to permit it; and in truth that other lechi suffices in height nineteen metsumtsamot from the manner of necessity that if you judge amot spaced — automatically the first lechi of four metsumtsamot has law of lechi and the mavo is permitted with one of those lechayim — examine well:
12:_: There in the Rama gloss: And some disagree. But with openings only through windows even when many together — nevertheless it is called two courtyards — Tosafos:
13:_: There: Two mashehuyin or tzurat hapetach. I question — behold tzurat hapetach that makes a reed from here and from here automatically there are two pasin — and how is it applicable to say or tzurat hapetach; for why trouble with a reed on them — requires study:
14:_: Magen Avraham s.k. 27: It implies he deals with enclosed by wall. See responsum Bach Chadashot siman 3:
15:_: Magen Avraham s.k. 35: The airspace comes. So is Rashi s.v. there is no halacha; but I wonder what this is needed for; for without this since two mavo'ot were not made the place of the pas reduces the air — nevertheless the mavo width is still more than ten amot through the two airspaces; for the airspaces are twenty amot minus the place of the pas and only through the pas the mavo is divided and becomes two mavo'ot; and behold in what they challenge afterward and why should he make pas of one amah etc. and he did not know the reasoning that airspace comes from this side etc.; and even so the pas in the middle would not help all the more; or as above; and requires study:
16:_: Even HaEzer 363:3 and proof for this from tractate Ohalot. To this R' Shneur Zalman intended in responsum of Shevut Yaakov part 3 siman 28:
17:_: Seif 34: Tzurat hapetach for the small one. It is not understood to one of small mind the reason for this; and I saw afterward in Levush who extended to give a reason; and still requires study:
18:_: Magen Avraham s.k. 37: And lechi is also required. So is explicitly in Yerushalmi beginning of Eruvin.
